description: Align the input polarizations incident on multiple SNSPDs by scanning their associated MPC320 controllers in parallel and using simultaneous TimeTagger count-rate feedback.

deviceIds.description: Device identifiers of the MPC320 controllers, each bound to one SNSPD-associated quantum-link sink in the active network.

measurementDurationSec.description: Integration duration for each simultaneous count sample, in seconds.

optimizationMode.description: Whether each controller angle is selected to maximize or minimize its linked SNSPD count rate.

initialPositionMode.description: Whether all selected paddles are moved to initialAnglesDeg before scanning, or remain at their current positions until their individual coarse scans begin.

paddles.description: MPC320 paddle indices to scan on every selected controller.

initialAnglesDeg.description: Initial scan angle for each selected paddle, in degrees.

finalAnglesDeg.description: Final scan angle for each selected paddle, in degrees.

stepDeg.description: Coarse scan angular increment in degrees.

refinements.description: Ordered optional whole-controller passes; each pass scans every selected paddle around the corresponding preceding-pass optimum and is bounded by the coarse scan endpoints.

items.description: One refinement-pass configuration applied to every selected paddle on every controller.

halfRangeDeg.description: Half-width of each paddle scan around its preceding-pass optimum, in degrees.

stepDeg.description: Angular increment for this local scan, in degrees.

settleAfterMoveSec.description: Settling delay after every parallel controller movement, in seconds.

moveTimeoutSec.description: Timeout for each MPC320 movement, in seconds.

link.polarizationAlignment.plan.topology.description: Resolved controller, quantum-link, TimeTagger, and channel bindings used by the alignment.

link.polarizationAlignment.status.multip.description: Terminal status, resolved topology, and scan summary for all selected SNSPD alignments.

link.polarizationAlignment.applied.selec.description: Selected MPC320 paddle angles keyed by controller identifier.

link.polarizationAlignment.observation.c.description: Count-rate samples keyed by MPC320 controller identifier.

link.polarizationAlignment.artifact.scan.description: NodeEngine-local JSON summaries and PNG scan curves written after each completed coarse or refinement pass.
